conventions.current_class: Defensible class using the accepted DOT-54 adapter and identity gate today.
conventions.target_class: Intended class only after every named raw input and release gate passes.
conventions.missing: Missing numerator or opportunity evidence produces null with a reason, never zero.
conventions.intervals: All time intervals are left-closed and right-open in calibrated game seconds; pauses do not advance windows.
conventions.positions: World-unit thresholds use a content-addressed patch/build map geometry version.
conventions.roles: Roster 1-5 is a report facet; dynamic responsibility segments are retained separately.
conventions.publication: Every rate publishes numerator, denominator, exclusions, sample size, class, confidence, and evidence IDs.

metrics.name: Lane presence share
metrics.business_meaning: How consistently a player occupied the lane assigned by observed early-game movement.
metrics.numerator: Eligible alive seconds inside the active lane polygon or its 1200-unit margin.
metrics.denominator: Eligible alive seconds in the lane segment.
metrics.opportunity: Each second with a verified player binding, calibrated clock, valid position, and stable lane segment.
metrics.time_window: 1-second resample; 30-second lane-change debounce.
metrics.space_window: Patch lane polygons plus 1200 world units.
metrics.algorithm: Count eligible second-grid samples in the active lane and divide by all eligible samples.
metrics.confidence: High only when position coverage is at least 95% and lane assignment meets share/margin gates; otherwise medium or unavailable.
known_biases: Heroes can contribute from outside the polygon
unusual trilanes make roster expectations misleading
metrics.test_case: 8771908040 ordinary-lane candidate plus a confirmed level-one swap fixture.

metrics.name: Core partner protection uptime
metrics.business_meaning: For supports, time spent in actionable proximity to the assigned lane core while that core faced lane pressure.
metrics.numerator: Threat-opportunity seconds with the support alive, within 1800 units, and not disabled/retreating beyond action range.
metrics.denominator: Core threat-opportunity seconds while both assigned partners are alive.
metrics.opportunity: Enemy hero within 2200 units of the core or verified hostile damage/control in the trailing 5 seconds.
metrics.time_window: Per second; threat persists 5 seconds after the last qualifying event.
metrics.space_window: Support-core 1800 units; enemy-core 2200 units.
metrics.algorithm: Construct threat opportunities, then measure actionable proximity over those opportunities.
metrics.confidence: Modelled probability with evidence features; release requires calibrated confidence and gold labels.
known_biases: proximity does not prove correct positioning
metrics.test_case: Manual partner-threat intervals in 8771908040.

metrics.name: Lane pressure damage per contact
metrics.business_meaning: Verified hero damage applied during eligible lane contacts, normalized by contact opportunity rather than game time.
metrics.numerator: Post-mitigation hero damage attributed to the player during eligible lane contacts.
metrics.denominator: Count of distinct 10-second lane-contact opportunities.
metrics.opportunity: Opposing real hero within 1800 units and both heroes alive for at least 2 seconds.
metrics.time_window: Contacts merge when separated by less than 5 seconds.
metrics.space_window: Same lane region and within 1800 units.
metrics.algorithm: Build contact intervals, sum qualifying damage, divide by opportunity count, and also publish raw damage.
metrics.confidence: Derived only with at least 98% actor/target resolution; otherwise unavailable.
known_biases: Damage can be strategically low value
healing and consumable cost are separate metrics
metrics.test_case: Gold-labelled lane contacts in all three probes.

metrics.name: Forced regeneration or retreat rate
metrics.business_meaning: How often lane pressure is followed by an opponent consuming regeneration or losing lane access.
metrics.numerator: Eligible pressure contacts followed within 12 seconds by verified regen use, base/behind-tower retreat for at least 8 seconds, or death.
metrics.denominator: Eligible pressure contacts initiated by the player/team.
metrics.opportunity: A lane contact with at least 8% max-health damage or qualifying control.
metrics.time_window: 12-second outcome window; events deduplicated per target/contact.
metrics.space_window: Lane region; retreat crosses versioned safe-boundary geometry.
metrics.algorithm: Score evidence features and output outcome probability plus raw evidence labels.
metrics.confidence: Modelled; never state that pressure caused the retreat without confidence and alternative signals.
known_biases: regen may be planned independent of pressure
metrics.test_case: Adjudicated pressure/retreat episodes in 8835684858.

metrics.name: Core safe last-hit opportunity conversion
metrics.business_meaning: How much of a core's plausibly safe creep economy was converted, separating opportunity from raw last hits.
metrics.numerator: Eligible lane/neutral creeps last-hit by the core.
metrics.denominator: Eligible creeps entering last-hit range while threat score stays below the published threshold.
metrics.opportunity: A verified enemy creep/neutral is attackable in range before death with stable player/creep positions.
metrics.time_window: Per creep from first eligible health/range state to death.
metrics.space_window: Attack/cast range plus 200 units; threat uses only observed replay truth offline.
metrics.algorithm: Generate per-creep opportunities, classify safety with a calibrated threat model, and publish conversions by safety band.
metrics.confidence: Modelled because safety is contextual; raw last-hit facts remain separate.
known_biases: Replay omniscience overstates information available to the player
metrics.test_case: Manual creep opportunities in the first 10 minutes of 8771908040.

metrics.name: Pull attempt success rate
metrics.business_meaning: Support manipulation of lane equilibrium through neutral-to-lane creep contact.
metrics.numerator: Attempts where an eligible neutral camp engages the intended allied lane wave for at least 3 seconds.
metrics.denominator: Verified pull attempts initiated by the player.
metrics.opportunity: Player aggro/order interaction with an alive neutral camp in a pull window and path toward the lane wave.
metrics.time_window: Attempt starts at aggro; result window 20 seconds.
metrics.space_window: Versioned camp, pull-path, and lane-intersection polygons.
metrics.algorithm: Deterministically identify initiator, path, and neutral-lane-wave contact.
metrics.confidence: Derived after >=0.90 precision and >=0.85 recall on annotated attempts.
known_biases: Unusual pull paths require geometry updates
success does not imply net lane value
metrics.test_case: Annotate every pull/stack-looking episode in 8771908040 and 8835684858.

metrics.name: Stack attempt success rate
metrics.business_meaning: Neutral camp stacking execution normalized by verified attempts.
metrics.numerator: Attempts followed by an increase in eligible camp unit generation above the prior camp baseline.
metrics.denominator: Verified stack attempts initiated during a camp spawn window.
metrics.opportunity: Player causes camp units to leave the spawn box within the versioned stack timing window.
metrics.time_window: From 8 seconds before the minute to 5 seconds after spawn.
metrics.space_window: Versioned camp spawn and leash polygons.
metrics.algorithm: Detect attempt and compare post-spawn camp composition with the pre-attempt baseline.
metrics.confidence: Derived only when spawn and ownership completeness are proven.
metrics.test_case: All visible camp manipulations across the three probes.

metrics.name: Creep wave manipulation events
metrics.business_meaning: Verified blocks, cuts, drags, and denied-wave reroutes as distinct atomic actions.
metrics.numerator: Count by subtype with initiator and affected wave identity.
metrics.denominator: Eligible wave/opportunity count for the subtype; raw counts are also published.
metrics.opportunity: A complete lane-wave lifecycle intersects the player's actionable region.
metrics.time_window: Per wave from spawn to death/despawn.
metrics.space_window: Versioned lane paths, aggro regions, and tower boundaries.
metrics.algorithm: Rule-based subtype classifier over wave paths and actor interactions.
metrics.confidence: Derived per subtype; unsupported subtype remains unavailable.
metrics.test_case: Manual wave-by-wave labels in the early-disruption probe.

metrics.name: Roam attempt rate
metrics.business_meaning: Cross-lane movement choices normalized by eligible lane time.
metrics.numerator: Lane departures lasting >=20 seconds that reach a different lane/objective region and create contact or objective presence.
metrics.denominator: Eligible alive minutes with a stable origin lane/responsibility segment.
metrics.opportunity: Stable origin lane plus valid position coverage and at least one reachable destination region.
metrics.time_window: Departure begins after 15 seconds outside lane; attempt must resolve within 90 seconds.
metrics.space_window: Origin lane distance >2500 units and entry into a different versioned region.
metrics.algorithm: Create deterministic movement attempts and classify destination/outcome separately from intent.
metrics.confidence: Derived for movement; intent label is modelled and separately exposed.
known_biases: Map-control moves may look like roams
lane swaps can be misclassified without hysteresis
metrics.test_case: 8835684858 must contain human-confirmed attempts or be replaced.

metrics.name: Roam conversion rate
metrics.business_meaning: Observable results following a roam without claiming the roam caused them.
metrics.numerator: Attempts followed by at least one labelled result: kill/assist, enemy retreat, rune, tower damage/death, Roshan/Tormentor, or space window.
metrics.denominator: Verified roam attempts.
metrics.opportunity: One record per roam attempt; each result label is evaluated independently.
metrics.time_window: Primary 30 seconds after arrival; secondary 60 seconds reported separately.
metrics.space_window: Destination region or within 3000 units of the contacted objective/fight.
exclusions: duplicate result shared across attempts without attribution rule
metrics.algorithm: Join attempts to predeclared outcomes within fixed windows and publish a multi-label result vector.
metrics.confidence: Derived association, explicitly not causal.
metrics.test_case: Every confirmed roam in 8835684858 with 30/60-second manual outcomes.

metrics.name: Failed roam resource cost
metrics.business_meaning: Observed lane/economy cost of roam attempts with no defined conversion.
metrics.numerator: Estimated missed XP/gold opportunities, tower damage conceded, and origin-core pressure during non-converting attempts.
metrics.denominator: Non-converting roam attempts.
metrics.opportunity: A verified roam with zero primary/secondary result labels.
metrics.time_window: From departure until return/new responsibility segment, capped at 120 seconds.
metrics.space_window: Origin lane and destination path/region.
metrics.algorithm: Compare observed opportunity loss with a documented local baseline; publish components, not one opaque penalty.
metrics.confidence: Modelled because the unobserved alternative action is uncertain.
known_biases: information gained is hard to value
metrics.test_case: Adjudicate non-converting attempts in the early-disruption probe.

metrics.name: Rune control contribution
metrics.business_meaning: Presence and actions that secure or deny a contested rune opportunity.
metrics.numerator: Eligible rune opportunities secured/denied while the player is present or contributes a qualifying control/damage action.
metrics.denominator: Eligible rune spawns for which the player could arrive under the declared reachability rule.
metrics.opportunity: Verified rune spawn with complete location, pickup/deny, and player positions.
metrics.time_window: 20 seconds before through 10 seconds after spawn.
metrics.space_window: Within 1800 units for presence; reachability uses path distance and current movement state.
metrics.algorithm: Create spawn opportunities and assign atomic presence/action labels; team result remains separate.
metrics.confidence: Derived for observed presence/action; strategic value is not scored.
known_biases: a player may intentionally concede a rune
metrics.test_case: Annotate all river/power rune windows in the ordinary and disruption probes.

metrics.name: Dangerous farm share
metrics.business_meaning: Farm collected in map regions with high observed threat, separated from hidden-information claims.
metrics.numerator: Gold/XP/last-hit value collected in the high observed-threat band.
metrics.denominator: All eligible farm value collected by the player in the phase.
metrics.opportunity: A verified farm event with player position and threat features from replay truth.
metrics.time_window: Threat features over trailing 10 seconds and next 3 seconds only for offline labelled analysis.
metrics.space_window: Versioned territory/control regions and observed enemy distance/reach.
metrics.algorithm: Publish farm by low/medium/high observed-threat probability; no binary safe claim.
metrics.confidence: Modelled and offline-only unless live GSI uses only delayed observed positions.
known_biases: player information and team calls are unknown
metrics.test_case: Long-game probe split-map intervals with manual danger bands.

metrics.name: Resource-to-objective conversion
metrics.business_meaning: Observable objective impact after a player/team gains a defined resource spike.
metrics.numerator: Tower/rax damage, objective deaths, Roshan/Tormentor results, or fight result within the fixed post-spike window.
metrics.denominator: Verified resource-spike opportunities by subtype.
metrics.opportunity: Item completion, level/ability breakpoint, Aegis acquisition, or team net-worth swing meeting a versioned threshold.
metrics.time_window: Report 60/120/180-second windows separately.
metrics.space_window: Objective/fight region; global economic spikes remain global.
exclusions: duplicate overlapping spikes without attribution split
metrics.algorithm: Create typed spike opportunities and join fixed-window atomic outcomes without causal wording.
metrics.confidence: Derived association; confidence depends on complete item/economy/objective inputs.
metrics.test_case: Long-game probe item/Aegis spikes and ensuing objectives.

metrics.name: Opportunity-adjusted item timing percentile
metrics.business_meaning: Item completion timing compared with like-role/hero/patch opportunities, without calling later timing poor when resources were unavailable.
metrics.numerator: Verified completion game second and accumulated eligible resource opportunity at completion.
metrics.denominator: A frozen reference distribution for same patch, hero-role task, and item with published sample size.
metrics.opportunity: Complete inventory lifecycle and eligible resource stream for the player.
metrics.time_window: From game second 0 to first completed ownership; disassembly/rebuy rules versioned.
metrics.space_window: Not applicable.
metrics.algorithm: Report raw timing, opportunity-adjusted timing, percentile, baseline N, and missingness.
metrics.confidence: Derived only with immutable eligible baseline; DOT-22 historical no-go means no current percentile is publishable.
metrics.test_case: Three probes validate extraction only; percentile remains unavailable until a TI baseline passes minima.

metrics.name: Side-lane pressure uptime
metrics.business_meaning: Time a player advances or holds a side lane while creating an observable response burden.
metrics.numerator: Eligible seconds advancing a side wave beyond the versioned pressure line with enemy response or structural threat evidence.
metrics.denominator: Eligible alive midgame/reset seconds assigned to side-lane responsibility.
metrics.opportunity: Stable side-lane segment with a complete wave and enemy/tower state.
metrics.time_window: 1-second samples; minimum pressure episode 15 seconds.
metrics.space_window: Side-lane pressure polygons and enemy response within 4000 units.
metrics.algorithm: Detect pressure episodes and output response/structure components separately.
metrics.confidence: Modelled because responsibility and response causality are uncertain.
known_biases: pressure without visible response may still create value
metrics.test_case: Split-map intervals in 8768555805.

metrics.name: Ward placement rate
metrics.business_meaning: Verified observer/sentry placements normalized by ward inventory opportunities.
metrics.numerator: Ward entity spawn events attributed to the player by ward type.
metrics.denominator: Eligible ward-carry minutes and available ward charges, reported separately.
metrics.opportunity: Verified ownership of a ward charge while alive; raw placements also published without a denominator.
metrics.time_window: Event time; opportunity sampled per second.
metrics.space_window: Exact verified placement coordinate/region.
metrics.algorithm: Join each ward spawn to the consuming inventory event and owner; count by type/phase/region.
metrics.confidence: Direct only with exact owner/entity correlation; otherwise unavailable.
known_biases: Placement count does not measure quality
metrics.test_case: Manual visible ward placements across all probes.

metrics.name: Ward lifetime share
metrics.business_meaning: How much of each ward's maximum legal lifetime was realized before deward/destruction.
metrics.numerator: Observed alive seconds from spawn to death/expiry/end censor.
metrics.denominator: Patch-defined maximum lifetime, right-censored at match end.
metrics.opportunity: Each verified ward entity spawn.
metrics.time_window: Ward lifecycle.
metrics.space_window: Placement region retained but not used in arithmetic.
metrics.algorithm: Compute lifecycle duration and censor type; aggregate distributions, not only mean.
metrics.confidence: Derived from direct lifecycle after completeness tests.
known_biases: Long lifetime is not always valuable
metrics.test_case: Ward lifecycles manually visible in the long probe.

metrics.name: Theoretical ward coverage seconds
metrics.business_meaning: Geometry-based potential coverage, explicitly distinct from actual visibility or decision value.
metrics.numerator: Ward-alive seconds multiplied by versioned visible-area estimate, reported by map region.
metrics.denominator: Optional team ward-alive seconds or region-time opportunity; raw area-seconds always separate.
metrics.opportunity: Verified ward coordinate/lifetime and matching map/vision geometry version.
metrics.time_window: Per second over ward lifetime.
metrics.space_window: Patch height/tree/blocker-aware theoretical vision polygon.
metrics.algorithm: Compute a labelled theoretical polygon; never join to enemy truth without a separate metric.
metrics.confidence: Modelled; confidence falls when dynamic blockers/trees are unknown.
known_biases: coverage area is not information value
metrics.test_case: Compare visible terrain occlusion around manually annotated wards in all probes.

metrics.name: Ward/enemy track intersection
metrics.business_meaning: Enemy trajectory intersecting a theoretical ward polygon, without claiming the enemy was actually seen or influenced a decision.
metrics.numerator: Enemy player-seconds whose replay track intersects the theoretical ward polygon while the ward is alive.
metrics.denominator: Enemy player-seconds in the selected map region, or ward-alive seconds; both variants named explicitly.
metrics.opportunity: Verified ward lifecycle plus complete enemy positions.
metrics.time_window: 1-second resample.
metrics.space_window: Theoretical ward polygon only.
metrics.algorithm: Calculate geometric intersections and label them potential track intersections.
metrics.confidence: Modelled; never upgraded to direct actual visibility.
known_biases: Replay hidden positions were not available to the team
metrics.test_case: Long-probe ward intervals with manually visible enemy crossings.

metrics.name: Deward opportunity conversion
metrics.business_meaning: Enemy wards destroyed when the player had observable detection and attack access.
metrics.numerator: Eligible enemy ward opportunities destroyed by the player/team within the opportunity window.
metrics.denominator: Verified opportunities with detection/reveal, range/path access, and an alive actor.
metrics.opportunity: Enemy ward exists and becomes detectable under verified sentry/gem/dust/true-sight state.
metrics.time_window: From first detection access until detection expires, ward dies, or actor leaves for 10 seconds.
metrics.space_window: Detection and attack/path range.
metrics.algorithm: Construct detection/access opportunities, then join destruction and actor evidence.
metrics.confidence: Modelled until visibility/detection reconstruction is validated.
known_biases: Team may intentionally leave a ward
replay omniscience must not define opportunity
metrics.test_case: All visible deward episodes in the three probes.

metrics.name: Smoke activation participation
metrics.business_meaning: Who used smoke, who received the modifier, and how the group moved before contact.
metrics.numerator: Typed smoke events/participations by user and affected player.
metrics.denominator: Verified smoke charges available to the team and eligible alive team members, reported separately.
metrics.opportunity: Smoke item consumption with modifier application lifecycle.
metrics.time_window: Activation to modifier end, capped by patch maximum.
metrics.space_window: Activation coordinate and participant paths.
metrics.algorithm: Join the consumed charge to modifier applications and retain each participant path.
metrics.confidence: Derived after exact item/modifier identity tests.
known_biases: Participation does not imply organizational credit
metrics.test_case: Every smoke episode in 8768555805; shallow count 22 is only a screening signal.

metrics.name: Smoke break/contact outcome
metrics.business_meaning: Observed events after a smoke ends or contacts the enemy, without calling a death beneficial.
metrics.numerator: Outcome vector: deaths/kills, objective damage/death, net-worth swing, disengage, and reset at 30/60/120 seconds.
metrics.denominator: Verified smoke end/contact events by reason class.
metrics.opportunity: Complete smoke modifier lifecycle with end reason/location and participant identities.
metrics.time_window: Separate 30, 60, and 120-second windows; no merged score.
metrics.space_window: Break/contact region and subsequent event regions.
exclusions: natural expiry mixed with enemy break
metrics.algorithm: Classify end evidence and publish a fixed-window outcome vector plus confidence.
metrics.confidence: Modelled for break cause/value; observed outcome components remain derived when inputs are complete.
known_biases: a support death may be good, neutral, or bad
metrics.test_case: Manual smoke timelines in the long and disruption probes.

metrics.name: Fight hero-damage share
metrics.business_meaning: Post-mitigation hero damage during a defined fight, retaining raw value and opportunity context.
metrics.numerator: Player-attributed real-hero damage inside the fight interval.
metrics.denominator: Team real-hero damage in the fight; active-alive seconds are also published as an opportunity denominator.
metrics.opportunity: Verified fight interval and complete actor/target/owner damage events.
metrics.time_window: Fight detector interval with <=10-second combat gaps.
metrics.space_window: Fight participant component/region; global spells retain source event.
metrics.algorithm: Sum qualifying damage by player and divide by team total; publish raw and per-active-second values.
metrics.confidence: Derived only with >=98% actor/target resolution for the interval.
known_biases: Damage quality and target priority differ
metrics.test_case: Adjudicated fights in all probes, especially long decisive rounds.

metrics.name: Effective control duration per opportunity
metrics.business_meaning: Verified disabling time applied to real enemy heroes, accounting for overlap and active opportunity.
metrics.numerator: Union duration of qualifying control modifiers attributed to the player, with overlapping control credited under a published rule.
metrics.denominator: Eligible ability/item cast opportunities while a real enemy target is in verified range/state.
metrics.opportunity: Ready control source, valid target in range, actor alive/not disabled, and complete cooldown/state evidence.
metrics.time_window: Modifier add-to-remove lifecycle; opportunities sampled per ready window.
metrics.space_window: Versioned cast/impact range including projectile rules.
metrics.algorithm: Reconstruct modifier intervals, apply resistance/overlap policy, and normalize by eligible opportunities.
metrics.confidence: Derived after modifier lifecycle completeness and overlap tests.
known_biases: Holding a spell can be correct
metrics.test_case: Manual control intervals in at least five fights across the probes.

metrics.name: Heal, dispel, and save casts
metrics.business_meaning: Atomic supportive effects delivered to allies, without claiming a life was saved.
metrics.numerator: Count and magnitude/duration by effect subtype, actor, target, and phase.
metrics.denominator: Eligible cast opportunities by ready source and valid ally target; raw counts also published.
metrics.opportunity: Ability/item ready, actor actionable, and at least one ally satisfies the documented target need/range rule.
metrics.time_window: Cast/impact event; need features over trailing 3 seconds.
metrics.space_window: Actual cast/impact range.
exclusions: self-only effect when metric requires ally
passive aura ticks unless separately defined
metrics.algorithm: Emit atomic effect facts; opportunity-normalized rate is a separate derived view.
metrics.confidence: Direct for verified cast/effect; opportunity rate is derived. No prevented-death claim.
known_biases: Effect magnitude may not equal strategic value
metrics.test_case: Manual supportive casts in each probe.

metrics.name: Initiation and counter-initiation participation
metrics.business_meaning: Evidence-backed ordering of who starts or responds to a fight.
metrics.numerator: Fight opportunities classified as initiator, co-initiator, counter-initiator, follow-up, or not involved.
metrics.denominator: Eligible verified fight intervals where the player is alive and within actionable reach.
metrics.opportunity: Fight onset with complete first damage/control/mobility/contact evidence.
metrics.time_window: 10 seconds before onset through 8 seconds after onset.
metrics.space_window: Fight component plus cast/reach paths.
exclusions: poke that does not enter fight
metrics.algorithm: Feature-based sequence classifier that outputs role probability and evidence events.
metrics.confidence: Modelled; low-confidence cases remain unclassified.
known_biases: bait and counterplay blur first action
metrics.test_case: Adjudicated onset roles for every major fight in 8768555805.

metrics.name: Key ability window conversion
metrics.business_meaning: Observable team/player outcomes while a declared high-impact ability/item window is available or committed.
metrics.numerator: Typed outcomes following a verified key cast or ready-window opportunity.
metrics.denominator: Eligible ready windows with a valid target/fight/objective opportunity.
metrics.opportunity: Declared ability/item ready, actor actionable, and versioned opportunity predicate true.
metrics.time_window: Per ready window; cast outcomes at 10/30/60 seconds by subtype.
metrics.space_window: Ability/item reach or global scope.
metrics.algorithm: Create opportunity records before observing outcomes and join fixed-window atomic results.
metrics.confidence: Derived association; strategic correctness remains modelled/unavailable.
metrics.test_case: Select two declared key abilities per lineup in each probe before evaluation.

metrics.name: Death without buyback exposure
metrics.business_meaning: Player-seconds a team is unavailable because a dead player lacks verified buyback during meaningful threat.
metrics.numerator: Dead seconds with buyback unavailable during verified objective/fight threat.
metrics.denominator: All dead seconds during verified objective/fight threat; raw unavailable seconds also published.
metrics.opportunity: Death interval with complete respawn and buyback state plus a threat interval.
metrics.time_window: Death to respawn/buyback; threat intersection.
metrics.space_window: Global round resource; threat has objective/fight region.
metrics.algorithm: Intersect verified death/resource intervals with threat intervals and sum seconds.
metrics.confidence: Derived only from complete round-resource state.
known_biases: Not having buyback may reflect earlier team resource allocation
metrics.test_case: All 12 buyback-event context windows in 8768555805.

metrics.name: Buyback round participation and outcome
metrics.business_meaning: What a player did after using buyback within a decisive round, without scoring the decision as correct.
metrics.numerator: Post-buyback participation facts: return time, damage/heal/control, deaths, objective/fight outcomes.
metrics.denominator: Verified buyback uses, grouped by available round context.
metrics.opportunity: Buyback event with actor, cost/availability, position, and round identity.
metrics.time_window: Use through round end; also fixed 30/60/120-second views.
metrics.space_window: Return path and fight/objective region.
exclusions: game end before participation reported as censor
metrics.algorithm: Join each use to its round and publish an outcome vector with no scalar quality score.
metrics.confidence: Derived outcomes; decision quality remains modelled and out of default scope.
metrics.test_case: 8768555805 long multi-round candidate.

metrics.name: High-ground building conversion
metrics.business_meaning: Verified structural damage/deaths following a high-ground siege opportunity.
metrics.numerator: Real tier-3/rax/ancient damage and deaths attributed to the team/player within the siege interval.
metrics.denominator: Verified siege opportunities where at least three attackers reach the high-ground threat region.
metrics.opportunity: Team shape `siege` with complete real-building and position state.
metrics.time_window: Siege entry to disengage/reset, with 20-second gap merge.
metrics.space_window: Versioned enemy high-ground/tier-3/rax polygons.
metrics.algorithm: Create siege opportunities and sum typed building outcomes; retain team and player contribution separately.
metrics.confidence: Derived after temporary-structure adversarial tests.
known_biases: Zoning contribution may not deal damage
building damage can be strategically traded
metrics.test_case: High-ground rounds in 8768555805; Underlord portal regression from 8741845584.

metrics.name: Reset execution evidence
metrics.business_meaning: Observable disengage, regroup, resource refresh, and re-entry behavior after a decisive round.
metrics.numerator: Reset episodes with survival, separation, resource refresh, and no avoidable re-contact under the published evidence rules.
metrics.denominator: Verified reset opportunities after decisive rounds.
metrics.opportunity: State machine enters reset with complete positions, combat, health/mana, buyback, and objective state.
metrics.time_window: Reset interval until midgame return or decisive re-entry.
metrics.space_window: Conflict centroid separation, base/shop/objective regions.
metrics.algorithm: Publish component evidence and a calibrated episode class; do not emit an opaque discipline score.
metrics.confidence: Modelled; strategic intent and opponent threat remain uncertain.
metrics.test_case: At least two reset/re-entry cycles in 8768555805.

metrics.name: Death prevented by a save
metrics.business_meaning: Research estimate that an allied save changed a death outcome.
metrics.numerator: Modelled probability mass of death avoided after a verified save effect.
metrics.denominator: Verified save-cast opportunities with sufficient pre/post state for the counterfactual model.
metrics.opportunity: Direct save cast/effect on an ally in lethal-threat context.
metrics.time_window: 5 seconds before through 10 seconds after effect, with longer effect-specific windows declared.
metrics.space_window: Fight/contact region or global ability scope.
metrics.algorithm: Compare explicit alternative simulations/models and publish probability range plus assumptions only in research output.
metrics.confidence: Counterfactual; never a factual count and never in the default player report.
metrics.test_case: Qualitative adjudication of save episodes; no three-game release claim.

metrics.name: Beneficial smoke-break sacrifice
metrics.business_meaning: Research estimate that one player's smoke contact/death prevented a worse team outcome.
metrics.numerator: Modelled reduction in expected team loss versus declared alternative contact paths.
metrics.denominator: Smoke-break/contact episodes with a verified breaker and sufficient state for alternatives.
metrics.opportunity: Verified smoke break/contact with team positions, resources, visibility assumptions, and ensuing outcome.
metrics.time_window: Break through 120 seconds, with pre-break state at 10 seconds.
metrics.space_window: Break region and alternative reachable team paths.
metrics.algorithm: Research-only alternative-outcome analysis; publish assumptions and uncertainty, never a binary positive contribution.
metrics.confidence: Counterfactual and excluded from default reports regardless of confidence.
known_biases: Alternative paths and team choices are unobserved
metrics.test_case: Manual narrative review of smoke contacts only; no automatic acceptance.
